headings: 7.2 Figure 7-2 Schematic - CPU and Power Supply
text: TC397 5V TFT Application Kit V2.0: S101 is the RESET button, causing a warm power-on reset. The reviewed schematic shows S101 driving transistor Q103 to pull the MCU /PORST net low. The low level describes /PORST, not the switch contact. This is a reset circuit, not a user GPIO input.

facts.level_at: MCU /PORST through Q103, not the switch contact

headings: 7.2 Figure 7-2 Schematic - CPU and Power Supply
text: TC397 5V TFT Application Kit V2.0: S102 is the WAKE button for the TLF35584 power-management device. The reviewed schematic shows pressing S102 connecting VIN through R137 and R115 to its WAK/ENA inputs, requesting enable/wakeup with a high level. These are PMIC inputs, not an MCU GPIO. Do not treat WAKE as a software-readable user button or infer an MCU pin or input voltage limit.

facts.level_at: TLF35584 WAK/ENA, not an MCU GPIO
